title: Touch of Madness
description:
• A deep, abstract story with multiple subliminal messages for player interpretation, featuring hand-drawn cutscenes.

• With a minimalist art style, you will often traverse the same environments in different realities.

• Neo – Gameplay focused on combat against enemies using firearms.

• Lavina – Gameplay focused on exploration, uncovering more about the story and hiding from enemies when necessary.
description_short: In this 2D Survival-Horror, you switch between two protagonists as you advance through the story: Neo, a man lost in his own mind, trying to survive an endless nightmare, and Lavina, a loyal friend who will do anything to try to save him.
